summary: I tested the frontend only, on the /cloudivr landing redesign (white background, near-black 'ink' buttons), on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844), plus a quick check of /cloudivr/sip. Every requested flow works. Hero: pure white background, centred heading, ink 'Get your number' button goes to /cloudivr/signup, outline 'Try a free call' button scrolls to #try. Product tabs: all 4 switch the screenshot, caption, URL pill and scene wrapper correctly; they auto-advance after about 7s and stop once a tab is clicked; Left/Right arrows change the selected tab; all 4 .webp screenshots load at 2160px wide. Nav: Products and Use cases menus open on hover and click and close on Escape; their featured cards are light grey with dark text; Coverage/Pricing/FAQ links scroll to the right sections; EN/FR/ES switching works. Rest of page: no civr-l-purple, civr-l-gridbg or civr-l-glow classes anywhere; feature tabs show a dark icon when selected; the free test call tabs show a black pill when selected; an invalid number shows civr-try-error; the Pro plan has the dark ring and black 'Recommended' badge; FAQ answers expand; the final call-to-action box and footer are light grey; the footer cookie link opens cookie settings; the chat button is dark and opens the panel. Mobile: no horizontal overflow (page width 390 = viewport width); product tabs scroll sideways; screenshot frame fits; hamburger menu is readable and its links work. No JS errors. Purple is still visible in two places: the cookie banner and the inside of the chat panel.

ui_bugs.issue: Arrow keys change the selected tab but keyboard focus stays on the old tab, which now has tabIndex=-1. Arrow keys still work afterwards because the keydown handler is on the tablist. WAI-ARIA tabs expect focus to follow the selection.

design_issues.screen: Cookie banner (shows on first visit and from footer Cookie settings)
issues: Leftover indigo #4f46e5: the Allow all button background, the Allow selection and Deny button borders, the Necessary toggle and the 'Show details' link. It is the first thing a new visitor sees over the white hero.
The button is now ink, but the panel itself is still a dark (black) theme with an indigo help icon and indigo send button. It clashes with the white landing page.
The native <select> dropdown options open with a dark/black background and white text on the white nav. They are readable but off-theme.
Tab labels (Dashboard, Keypad menus, Campaigns, Live map) and captions stay in English after switching to FR/ES, while the hero title is translated.
The eyebrow pill wraps onto 2 lines and the green dot sits off-centre to the left. Consider shorter text on mobile.
The floating chat button (support-chat-toggle) sits on top of the open mobile menu and covers item descriptions.
The page loads and its buttons are ink pills. The hero still has a purple 'any SIP phone' highlight and a faint grid/checker background with a violet glow.

action_items: Restyle the cookie banner (cookie-allow-all, cookie-allow-selection, cookie-deny, the toggles and Show details) from indigo #4f46e5 to ink/slate so it matches the landing page
Optional: give the support chat panel a light theme on the landing page (white background, ink send button) instead of dark + indigo
Optional: in HeroTabs pick(), move focus to the newly selected tab button on Arrow keys (roving tabindex)
Optional: translate the HeroTabs labels and captions for FR/ES
Optional: remove the purple highlight and grid background on the /cloudivr/sip hero for consistency
critical_code_review_comments: HeroTabs.js: keys() calls pick() but never calls .focus() on the new tab, which breaks the roving-tabindex pattern
HeroTabs.js: TABS labels and captions are hard-coded English strings and do not go through the i18n mechanism
cloudivr.css still defines .civr-l-gridbg with an rgba(99,102,241) grid, so it is still available for other pages such as SIP
Purple (#6366f1 / #818cf8) is used only inside the dark Platform mockups (feature-ivr-mock etc.), which is expected per the request
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 155 covered only the landing redesign. All requested landing testids worked. A computed-style scan for purple, run after scrolling the whole page, found it only inside feature-ivr-mock (expected), plus the cookie banner (#4f46e5) and the chat panel internals. Mobile at 390px has no horizontal overflow. Dismiss the cookie banner with cookie-deny first. The FAQ uses <details>/<summary>, so aria-expanded is absent and that is fine.
